metadata.title: Learning Management System (LMS) – Data SSPP Overlay
metadata.remarks: Application-specific Secure Data overlay defining constraints for educational data handled by Learning Management Systems.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: LMS data handling inherits all Secure Data protections and lifecycle governance.

props.name: data-classification-assumption
props.remarks: Student academic records and submissions are treated as regulated personal data by default.

props.name: retention-boundary
props.remarks: Retention aligns with academic, accreditation, and legal requirements.

props.name: analytics-constraint
props.remarks: Learning analytics must not reuse data beyond declared instructional and assessment purposes.

control-implementation.remarks: The LMS relies on Secure Data for classification, encryption, DLP, and retention. The LMS may not redefine data governance rules.
